concept.description: Venn diagram representing the intersection of highest quality course content and excellent student service
concept.symbolism: Circles that overlap show commonality - represents Aptly's values and purpose

horizontal.recommendation: Use when logo needs to be aligned to the left or right

vertical.recommendation: Use when logo needs to be aligned centrally on a format

icon.usage: For small spaces or social media profile icons
icon.features: Three distinct color backgrounds for adaptability

wordmark.usage: Text-only version for pairing with client logos

monochrome.allowed: Black and white for B&W printings only
monochrome.restriction: Cannot be used in white or any other stand-alone color

sizing.clearspace: Equal to logo height on all sides

clientLogos.spacing: Minimum space equals wordmark length divided by 2
clientLogos.heightRule: Aptly wordmark and client logo must be equal height

primaryFont.name: DM Sans
primaryFont.description: Low-contrast geometric sans serif design for smaller text sizes
primaryFont.coverage: Latin Extended glyph set for English and Western European languages
primaryFont.baseFont: Latin portion of Indian Type Foundry's Poppins
primaryFont.update: May 2023 - expanded to Thin & ExtraBlack (100-1000 weight range) with optical size axis

gradient.description: Transitions smoothly from Navy to Light Teal
gradient.requirements: Ensure high contrast when placing text over gradient
gradient.restrictions: Avoid altering gradient colors or introducing new gradients

people.situations: Multiple situations from abstract to realistic
people.expressions: Faces and hands must be expressive, showing different emotions
people.shadows: Must in clothing, can include natural light effects
people.diversity: Represent variety of roles, ages, and backgrounds

animals.behavior: Can have human behaviors (reading, studying, using phone)
animals.gradients: Can use gradients to add depth to bodies (tails, ears)

shadowsAndLights.layering: Apply overlays on separate layers with blending modes

rules.colorRequirement: Must have teal, purple and navy on them
rules.colorLimit: Try not exceed from 6 or 7 colors per illustration
rules.elements: Can go out from frame with proportional body sizing
rules.secondaryElements: Can be in grey, not full colored
rules.darkColors: Use lighter color instead of shadowing if too dark

guidelines.styleAndTone: Flat design with modern, clean, simplistic approach; friendly and approachable with professional tone
guidelines.composition: Balanced and clean layouts avoiding clutter; focus on clear visual storytelling
guidelines.colorPalette: Vibrant yet cohesive color scheme reflecting branding; bold colors for primary elements, softer tones for backgrounds
guidelines.typography: Clean, legible, friendly typography that complements illustration style
guidelines.characterDesign: Diverse, inclusive characters with consistent rounded shapes and simplified features
guidelines.iconography: Simple, recognizable icons with consistent stroke weights avoiding over-detailing
guidelines.accessibility: High contrast for readability; consider color blindness and visual impairments
guidelines.scalability: Scalable at various sizes; avoid intricate details lost in smaller sizes
guidelines.emotionalTone: Evoke desired emotional response using facial expressions and body language

selection.source: Adobe - high-quality imagery selected by curators
selection.content: People, lifestyle, digital, devices explaining Aptly processes literally
selection.style: Minimalistic pictures instead of busy; fewer elements for more focus

gradients.usage: Apply dark gradient overlay when adding text on images
gradients.purpose: Ensure text remains readable and stands out clearly
gradients.frequency: Use sparingly, primarily for text accessibility
gradients.graphics: All ornamental graphics must use main color palette

circles.usage: Fill and stroke circles for branding elements
circles.hierarchy: Filled circles for main elements, stroked for secondary

instagram.approach: Blend of inspiration, education, and community engagement
instagram.style: Rich, engaging colors and inclusive illustrations

facebook.approach: Dynamic mix of inspiration, education, and community interaction

phoneUI.requirement: All Phone UIs must have Phone frame
phoneUI.purpose: Production Team needs frames for final video look

desktopUI.requirement: All Desktop UIs must have Desktop frame
desktopUI.purpose: Production Team needs frames for final video look

process: Zoom in the part of image desired for highlight
Add rounded corner border in Aptly Yellow (#FFDE00)
highlights.responsibility: Design Team delimits highlight area in storyboard; Production Team creates final look

requirements: Logo must be displayed and easily discernible
Include sufficient white space around logo
Work within CMYK color space for printing consistency
Specified logo size, placement, and color guidelines
Color palette alignment with brand identity
Accurate logo representation in size, placement, and color
Review digital proofs for brand guideline alignment

characteristics: No exclamation marks unless in CTAs
callToAction: View Courses (not Browse Our Awesome Courses)
